source: Commission main at 552f0d5 and its AEP planning store

items.label: Responsibility model
items.detail: Generated from ess/ into Rust and re-exported as b10x_commission::model. Never written by hand.

items.label: Governor, AgentExecutor and AuthorityProvider ports
items.detail: A failing authority provider is turned into a refusal, never an allow.

items.label: Observation and evidence ports
items.detail: Nothing turns an observation, executor output or trace into evidence.

items.label: Frontier admission
items.detail: The least-authority entry wins when an action is listed more than once.

items.label: Action-request revalidation
items.detail: Stale revision, frontier admission and approval required, checked immediately before use.

items.label: Run outcomes; start, suspend and resume
items.detail: Runs are held in memory; a suspended run does not survive a restart.

items.label: Local runtime loop
items.detail: run_until_blocked drives one commission over its ports until its run ends. It records requests and executes no effect.

items.label: Suspend and resume across a process restart
items.detail: A run suspended for approval resumes in a new process at the same case revision.

items.label: Test fakes for governor, executor and authority
Adapter conformance kits
items.detail: A governor or authority-provider adapter runs the kit in b10x-commission-testkit against its own implementation.

items.label: ESS conformance suite
items.detail: task check runs the suite synthesized from ess/ against b10x-commission.

items.label: Repository gates
items.detail: Strict ESS gate, generated-code drift, no hand-written model types, no Loom or model-provider dependency, reference-page drift.

items.label: Vertical slices
items.detail: Software-change, incident and suspend/resume cases end to end through Commission and Loom, as integration tests.
